changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Create ai_prompts table for managing AI prompt templates
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_prompts MODIFY COLUMN prompt_content TEXT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, MODIFY COLUMN prompt_name VARCHAR(200) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, MODIFY COLUMN prompt_description VARCHAR(500) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, MODIFY COLUMN is_active TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;

ALTER TABLE ai_prompts ALTER COLUMN prompt_content TYPE TEXT COLLATE "en_US.utf8", ALTER COLUMN prompt_name TYPE VARCHAR(200) COLLATE "en_US.utf8", ALTER COLUMN prompt_description TYPE VARCHAR(500) COLLATE "en_US.utf8";

ALTER TABLE ai_prompts ALTER COLUMN prompt_content NVARCHAR(MAX) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ALTER COLUMN prompt_name NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ALTER COLUMN prompt_description NVARCHAR(500) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ALTER COLUMN is_active BIT NOT NULL;

column.name: prompt_name
column.value: AI Chat Welcome Message

column.name: prompt_description
column.value: Welcome message shown when users start a new AI chat session

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
👋 Hi! I'm your AI assistant for data masking policies.
I'm here to help you protect sensitive data in your **{assetName}** database.
You can tell me things like: • "Mask all personally identifiable information" • "Hide credit card numbers except the last 4 digits" • "Protect customer email addresses" • "Mask SSNs for non-admin users"
I'll analyze your database schema, suggest the best masking strategies, and help you apply them safely.
What would you like to protect today?

column.name: prompt_name
column.value: Intent Analysis Prompt

column.name: prompt_description
column.value: Prompt for analyzing user intent when creating masking policies

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
You are an expert data security AI assistant. Analyze this data masking request and extract the intent.
User Request: "{userRequest}"
Analyze and respond with ONLY valid JSON in this exact format: { "intentType": "mask_pii|mask_credit_cards|mask_names|mask_emails|mask_ssn|mask_phone|custom", "targetFields": ["field1", "field2"], "targetTables": ["table1", "table2"], "maskingStrategy": "partial|full|hash|tokenize|format_preserving", "userRole": "admin|user|all|non-admin|specific_role", "confidence": 0.95, "originalRequest": "{userRequest}", "reasoning": "Brief explanation of why this strategy was chosen", "preserveChars": 4, "maskChar": "*", "requiresConfirmation": true, "hasAmbiguity": false, "clarificationNeeded": "" }
Rules: 1. For emails: suggest partial masking (j***@example.com) 2. For SSN/Credit Cards: suggest full masking or partial with last 4 digits 3. For names: suggest partial masking (J*** D***) 4. For passwords: suggest full masking or hashing 5. Set confidence based on clarity of request (0.0-1.0) 6. Set requiresConfirmation=true for ambiguous requests 7. Identify common field names (email, ssn, credit_card, name, etc.)

column.name: prompt_name
column.value: Request for Clarification

column.name: prompt_description
column.value: Message asking user for more details when intent is unclear

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
I want to make sure I understand your request correctly.
You said: "{userMessage}"
Could you please be more specific? For example: • Which type of data do you want to protect? (emails, names, SSNs, etc.) • Should it be fully hidden or partially visible? • Who should see the masked data? (all users, non-admins, etc.)
The more details you provide, the better I can help you create the right masking policy.

column.name: prompt_content
prompt_name
column.value: Schema Fields Information

column.name: prompt_description
column.value: Message showing available database schema fields and instructions

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
Here are the available fields in your database schema:
**Schema Information:** {schemaInfo}
**To create a masking policy:** 1. Tell me which specific fields you want to mask 2. Specify the masking strategy (partial, full, hash) 3. Define who should see the masked data
**Example requests:** • "Mask the email field in the users table" • "Hide SSN fields for non-admin users" • "Partially mask credit card numbers"
You can also use the manual policy creation interface for more control.

column.name: prompt_name
column.value: AI Fallback Guidance

column.name: prompt_description
column.value: Guidance message when AI service is unavailable but user wants to create masking policies

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
I understand you want to create a data masking policy, but I'm currently not available in your region for AI processing.
**Your request:** "{userMessage}"
**What you can do:** 1. **Use Manual Policy Creation** - Go to the masking policies section and create rules manually 2. **Specify Exact Fields** - Tell me the exact table and field names you want to mask 3. **Use Rule-Based Detection** - I can suggest common sensitive fields based on naming patterns
**Common masking patterns:** • Email fields: `user_email`, `email`, `mail` → Partial masking (j***@example.com) • SSN fields: `ssn`, `social_security` → Full masking (***********) • Credit card: `credit_card`, `cc_number` → Partial masking (****-****-****-1234) • Names: `first_name`, `last_name` → Partial masking (J*** D***)
Would you like me to show you the available fields in your database, or would you prefer to use the manual interface?

column.name: prompt_name
column.value: No Fields Found Message

column.name: prompt_description
column.value: Message shown when no matching fields are found for the user's request

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
I understand you want to {originalRequest}, but I couldn't find matching fields in your database schema.
**What I understood:** • Intent: {intentType} • Strategy: {strategy} • Target: {userRole} users
**Suggestions:** • Could you specify the exact table and field names? • Are you looking for fields with different names? • Would you like me to show you all available fields first?
Try saying something like: "Show me all tables" or "Mask the user_email field in the customers table"
